name: Windsor County, VT
findings: Windsor County has 323 nonprofit organizations. 99 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 87 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Windsor County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 18 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Windsor County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
